sentences.en: He tried to convince them of his innocence in vain.
sentences.zh: 他徒劳地试图让他们相信自己的清白。

sentences.en: He tried in vain to convince them of his innocence.
sentences.zh: 他徒劳地试图证明自己的清白。

sentences.en: Innocence, most often, is a blessing and not a virtue.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，天真无邪是一种福气而不是美德。

senses.zh: 清白,天真无邪,无罪的人
